en: turning around the name of Eva.
Loose the chains of the guilty,
bring out light for the blind,
Show yourself to be a mother:
may he take up our prayer through you
make us, loosed from our faults,
we may rejoice together for ever.
Praise be to God the Father,
to the three one honour. Amen.
notes: line 2.4: 'mutans Evae nomen': 'Ave' is 'Eva' (Eve) read backwards, Mary undoing Eve's fall.
line 4.2: 'precem' has no 'our' in the Latin: 'the prayer'.
line 4.4: 'tulit esse tuus', literally 'bore to be yours', i.e. took on being your son.
